changeSet.author: oriso
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO legacy_chat_identifier_archive (entity_type, entity_id, legacy_rc_group_id, matrix_room_id, migration_status) SELECT 'session', id, rc_group_id, matrix_room_id, CASE WHEN rc_group_id LIKE '!%:%' THEN 'MATRIX_ID_BACKFILL' WHEN matrix_room_id LIKE '!%:%' THEN 'MATRIX_ID_PRESENT' ELSE 'LEGACY_ID_REQUIRES_ACTION' END FROM session WHERE rc_group_id IS NOT NULL AND rc_group_id != '' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE legacy_rc_group_id = VALUES(legacy_rc_group_id), matrix_room_id = VALUES(matrix_room_id), migration_status = VALUES(migration_status), archived_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

changeSet.author: oriso
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO legacy_chat_identifier_archive (entity_type, entity_id, legacy_rc_group_id, matrix_room_id, migration_status) SELECT 'chat', id, rc_group_id, matrix_room_id, CASE WHEN rc_group_id LIKE '!%:%' THEN 'MATRIX_ID_BACKFILL' WHEN matrix_room_id LIKE '!%:%' THEN 'MATRIX_ID_PRESENT' ELSE 'LEGACY_ID_REQUIRES_ACTION' END FROM chat WHERE rc_group_id IS NOT NULL AND rc_group_id != '' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE legacy_rc_group_id = VALUES(legacy_rc_group_id), matrix_room_id = VALUES(matrix_room_id), migration_status = VALUES(migration_status), archived_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

preConditions.onFailMessage: Rocket.Chat-only room IDs remain. Inspect legacy_chat_identifier_archive and provision Matrix room IDs before retrying.

changeSet.author: oriso
changeSet.sql: UPDATE session SET matrix_room_id = rc_group_id WHERE (matrix_room_id IS NULL OR matrix_room_id = '') AND rc_group_id IS NOT NULL AND rc_group_id LIKE '!%:%'

rollback.sql: UPDATE session s JOIN legacy_chat_identifier_archive a ON a.entity_type = 'session' AND a.entity_id = s.id SET s.rc_group_id = a.legacy_rc_group_id, s.matrix_room_id = a.matrix_room_id

changeSet.author: oriso
changeSet.sql: UPDATE chat SET matrix_room_id = rc_group_id WHERE (matrix_room_id IS NULL OR matrix_room_id = '') AND rc_group_id IS NOT NULL AND rc_group_id LIKE '!%:%'
